note: What a client sends to use a unit: as its player right-clicks a unit its character data makes usable by them and off its use cooldown. The header names the unit using it.

revisions.note: A client also sends it as a unit its champion is attacking changes side (TeamChanged), whether usable or not.
A client also sends it as a champion, a minion or a turret changes side (TeamChanged), whether usable or not: once for each unit it holds whose target that unit is, naming that unit in the header.

fields.name: target
fields.note: The unit to use, or the unit that changed side.

revisions.note: As a champion, a minion or another unit with a mind changes side (TeamChanged), a client also sends it naming that unit, for every unit with a mind it holds that targets it, with that unit in the header; a building changing side sends none.
A client also sends it as a unit its champion is attacking changes side (TeamChanged), whether usable or not.
A client also sends it as a unit its champion is attacking changes side (TeamChanged), whether usable or not.

A client also sends it as a unit with a mind (a champion, a minion, a turret, a map prop or a follower) changes side (TeamChanged): one for each unit it holds whose target that unit is, stopping what that unit is doing first, with the header naming it and target the unit that changed side, whether usable or not. A building changing side brings none.

A client also sends it as a unit changes side (TeamChanged): for each unit it holds whose target that unit is, naming it in target and the attacking unit in the header, whether usable or not, and clears that target.
